name: PingPlotter
description_en:
PingPlotter diagnoses network paths by repeatedly measuring latency, packet loss and jitter. Desktop editions trace from a local computer; PingPlotter Cloud deploys agents to remote workstations, servers or cloud VMs and presents their observations in a central browser interface. These are different collection and subscription choices.

Use the destination and the affected application as anchors for diagnosis. A poorly responding intermediate router alone is insufficient evidence of a broken link. Preserve relevant trace sessions before sharing an incident or moving the desktop installation.
description_zh:
PingPlotter 通过重复测量延迟、丢包和抖动诊断网络路径。桌面版从本机跟踪；PingPlotter Cloud 将代理部署到远端工作站、服务器或云 VM，在浏览器集中展示观察结果，两者的采集及订阅方式不同。

诊断应以终点和受影响应用为参照。单个中间路由器响应较差，不足以证明链路故障。分享事件或迁移桌面安装前，应保留相关跟踪会话。

core_features.explanation_en: Cloud agents collect path measurements from the networks being investigated.
core_features.explanation_zh: Cloud 代理从待调查网络内部采集路径测量。

core_features.explanation_en: Compare intermediate loss with downstream and destination behavior before attributing a fault.
core_features.explanation_zh: 归因前将中间跳点丢包与下游、终点表现比较。

core_features.explanation_en: Autosave can keep all targets, sessions beyond a duration, or explicitly selected targets.
core_features.explanation_zh: 自动保存可保留所有目标、达到时长的会话或明确选择的目标。

en: Compare an affected endpoint with the local gateway during a reproducible connection problem.
Export a selected session and rehearse desktop backup/restore on disposable data.
zh: 在可复现连接问题期间比较受影响终点与本地网关。
导出选定会话，用可丢弃数据演练桌面备份／恢复。
use_cases.basis: Proposed evaluation tasks derived from documentation; no observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Choose Desktop or Cloud, select an authorized target and record the affected application’s symptom times.
steps.zh: 选择 Desktop 或 Cloud、获准目标，并记录应用症状时间。

steps.en: Set session retention, verify PP2 export and review edition limits before subscribing.
steps.zh: 设置会话保留、验证 PP2 导出，订阅前核对版本限制。

items.en: Intermediate packet loss or unreachable probes alone do not establish application downtime.
items.zh: 仅中间丢包或探测不可达不能证明应用停机。

items.en: Moving the data folder requires an explicit copy; restore replaces existing files.
items.zh: 迁移数据目录需明确复制，恢复会替换现有文件。

pricing.summary_en: Free is a limited local edition. Paid starting rates are Standard $6.99/month, Professional $29/month and Cloud $90/month; perpetual/volume options and Cloud annual terms are separate.14-day Desktop and7-day Cloud trials are temporary. Exact checkout, taxes, Cloud agent quantities and feature entitlements remain unverified.
pricing.summary_zh: Free 为受限本地版。付费起价为 Standard 每月 $6.99、Professional $29、Cloud $90；永久／批量及 Cloud 年付另有选项。桌面十四天和 Cloud 七天均为临时试用。最终结算、税费、Cloud 代理数量及功能权益待核。

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_zh: 选择本地或分布式采集
sections.en: Cloud separates agents, cloud collection and the administrative interface. Agents use ping and traceroute and report from their own network perspective. Device-based subscriptions support monthly or annual terms. Plan placement around the affected location and required simultaneous agents; a local desktop trace does not reproduce every remote user’s path.
sections.zh: Cloud 区分代理、云端采集和管理界面。代理使用 ping／traceroute，从自身网络位置上报。按设备订阅支持月付或年付，应按受影响地点和同时使用的代理数量规划；本机跟踪不能重现所有远端用户路径。

sections.title_zh: 中间跳点警告需要上下文
sections.en: The interpretation guide shows intermediate packet loss with a healthy destination and explains that some routers deprioritize ICMP responses. Loss continuing downstream is more relevant than an isolated hop. An unreachable result may reflect blocked probes rather than a failed website. Correlate timestamps with an observed application symptom; a graph pattern remains a diagnostic lead.
sections.zh: 解释指南展示中间跳点丢包而终点正常的情况，并说明部分路由器降低 ICMP 响应优先级。延续到下游的丢包比孤立跳点更有意义。不可达也可能是探测被阻断，并非网站故障。应将时间戳与应用症状对应，图形模式仍只是诊断线索。

sections.en: Desktop v5 autosave offers Always, After a configured duration, or Only when selected. The session manager can reopen, delete or export stored sessions as PP2 files. Changing the data-storage location does not copy old data/settings automatically. Verify the chosen session survives reopening and copy existing content explicitly during relocation.
sections.zh: 桌面 v5 自动保存支持 Always、达到指定时长及 Only when selected。会话管理器可重开、删除或导出 PP2。改变存储位置不会自动复制旧数据／设置，应验证会话能重新打开，迁移位置时明确复制原内容。

sections.title_en: Back up both execution contexts when needed
sections.title_zh: 按运行方式备份所需目录
sections.en: The backup guide distinguishes Windows application/service data and macOS application/background-mode data. It calls for closing the app and stopping its service before copying or restoring the relevant PingPlotter 5 folders. Restoration replaces files in their original locations. Rehearse on a disposable installation and retain the pre-restore state.
sections.zh: 备份指南区分 Windows 应用／服务及 macOS 应用／后台模式的数据。复制或恢复相关 PingPlotter 5 目录前须关闭应用并停止服务，恢复会替换原位置文件。应在可丢弃安装上演练，并保留恢复前状态。

sections.title_en: Keep target limits and Cloud fees separate
sections.title_zh: 分别核对目标上限与 Cloud 费用
sections.en: The comparison page lists Standard from $6.99/month for two targets on one computer, Professional from $29/month for local multi-target use, and Cloud from $90/month. Desktop trials last 14 days; Cloud’s trial lasts 7. A separate Free edition allows one connection without remote collection and lists 10-minute history. Blank comparison cells do not prove feature inclusion.
sections.zh: 比较页列 Standard 每月 $6.99 起、单机两个目标，Professional 每月 $29 起、单机多目标，Cloud 每月 $90 起。桌面试用十四天，Cloud 七天。独立 Free 版允许一个连接、无远程采集，列有十分钟历史。空白比较单元格不能证明功能包含。
